optionalWidening.text: `{{slot}}` is a '{{source}}', seen here as '{{target}}', which adds the optional property `{{property}}` that '{{source}}' does not declare. A '{{source}}' can still carry a `{{property}}` of any type, since an earlier, wider value may have been seen as it, and tsc now gives that property the optional one's type: the value reads as a '{{propertyType}}' and holds something else. Declare `{{property}}` in the source's type, or build the value with the property named.
